mapper.select: SELECT f.question AS question, COALESCE(SUM(s.`count`), 0) AS count FROM tb_faq_daily_stats s INNER JOIN tb_attraction_faq f ON s.faq_id = f.id WHERE s.attraction_id = #{attractionId} AND s.`date` >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY s.faq_id, f.question ORDER BY count DESC
